text_block_list.text: The scorching summer sunlight beat down day after day—

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: Hmph...!!

Day by day, the anxiety was wiped away.
The abnormalities we feared had vanished
without a trace...

"Neo Universe's running became better
than anything seen before."
And then came—the final week of the training camp.

An unknown girl—stood there.
A Neo Universe that exists in no other cosmos.
Her keen intellect remained unchanged. However, her sheer ruggedness was transformed beyond recognition...

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
Trainer... Neo Universe
offers 'gratitude.'

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
...No. "Deep gratitude," "cheers of joy," "APPR"...
None of them feel right...

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: How... should I put it...?

There was no need for it. Just by looking at each other like this,
so much information comes across.
"It was because of this relationship that we were able to cross the 'GATE'. We are truly two halves of a whole."
Even so, Neo Universe... gave me just a single word.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: ...'Thank you.'

And Neo Universe isn't the only one
who has grown stronger over this summer.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: —Uni-san.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: Zenno Rob Roy...

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
In my own way... I was worried.
Even without knowing the full story...

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Uni-san must be going through a really tough time.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
"Still... here we are.
Both of us, making it this far!"

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
I shall step across the garden of thorns.
And you, Uni-san, shall cast away the dark shadows!

The gentleness in her eyes was the same as before.
Yet the inner strength welling up within was completely different.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
The coming autumn. What I aim to become is a hero.
Yet a hero is—

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
“No one does it alone.” In every book,
there's always "a certain companion" by the hero's side.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
"A certain comrade"...
Standing beside a hero is always...

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
"Neo Uni"...
A hero and... "Neo Uni".

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Huh... Neo Uni...?
Is that... an occupation...?

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
No, but let's go with that!
A hero and Neo Uni...!

Eeeeh, beside a Hero should be
a "Mage", right~ !?

Just then, an Umamusume wearing a witch's hat
came along.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
I'm the one who should be standing there!
I finally made my debut, so if you don't let me join in,
no, no, no waaaay!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Still, Sweep-san.
You're still in the Classic Class...

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Hmph! Once the Shuka Sho in the autumn is over,
I'll be able to join right in!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Just you watch. Rob Roy, Universe, I'm gonna turn both of you into konpeito with my magic!

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
"Kompeito candy...
Like 'twinkling stars', aren't they?"

Sweep Tosho, the witch Umamusume,
bursts in boisterously. Seeing her...

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: Trainer... "REVE"...

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: This is part of the "RÊVE" too, isn't it...

Emerging from the dark sector of space... the view expands.
Neo Universe seemed to sense
a new circle of companionship forming.
And that night—

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Uni-san. Please listen without laughing.
This autumn, I absolutely must...

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: There's a chapter I want to add to my own story.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: "Chapters"? That is—

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: —This chapter is about claiming the Autumn Senior Triple Crown.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: In other words, total domination across three GⅠ races: the Tenno Sho (Autumn), Japan Cup, and Arima Kinen!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
"In my story, there is still no chapter
where I play an absolute starring role..."

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
As long as I aim to be a true hero, I want to write that chapter.
Without fail, this autumn...!

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
Zenno Rob Roy... Yes.
You might not know this, but...

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
Zenno Rob Roy has done it—
She has achieved the Autumn Senior Triple Crown.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Huh? What do you mean, accomplished...?

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: For a moment, she soared. But—

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
In the vast history of the cosmos...
it is but the fleeting sparkle of a "MOOM"...

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: I couldn't "carry on the torch"...

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: So Neo Universe won't... let it be taken so easily.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
There is also "FUNV" from "Fall."
By capturing each other, the wormhole becomes a sphere.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
"Wishing for that—I came all this way.
...Across the stars."

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Uni-san... I might not understand it well, but...

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
I look forward to working with you...! Because I consider this chapter
to be the chapter of me and Uni-san!
We've arrived at a new sector of space. The first thing to do is to check in on the "present" with Zenno Rob Roy.

Two who were never supposed to stand side by side again,
are now—
Standing side by side—we looked up at the same starry sky.
